title: hahnia intermedia
intro: Hahnia intermedia, commonly known as the Hahnia fern or the intermedia fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is native to various parts of the world, including Asia and the Pacific Islands. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as acting as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant.
